announcements.text: The Lockheed Martin Corp., Rotary and Mission Systems, Mitchel Field, New York, is awarded a $122,449,494 cost-plus-incentive-fee and cost-plus-fixed-fee contract (N0003027C3015) to provide Strategic Weapon System Trident Fleet Support, Trident II SSP Shipboard Integration Increment 8, Navigation Subsystem development efforts. This contract award also benefits a foreign military sale to the United Kingdom. This value includes optional line items, if exercised. Work will be performed in Mitchel Field, New York (77%); Huntington Beach, California (20%); Manassas, Virginia (2%); and various other locations (less than 1% each, 1% total). Work is expected to be completed by Oct. 31, 2030. This action is awarded subject to the availability of funds in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul 52.232-18. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds in the amount of $3,967,324; fiscal 2027 other procurement, Navy funds in the amount of $12,257,072; and fiscal 2027 shipbuilding and conversion, Navy funds in the amount of $12,966,189, will be obligated on this award. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract is being awarded as a sole-source pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1) and (4). Portfolio Acquisition Executive Strategic Systems Programs, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: The Boeing Co., Seattle, Washington, is awarded a $119,654,234 cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00001) to a previously issued order (N0001926F1095) against a basic ordering agreement (N0001926G1002). This modification exercises options to procure nine retrofit A-kits, seven for Navy P-8A Poseidon aircraft and two for Royal Australian Air Force P-8A aircraft, incorporating Increment Three Block Two engineering change Proposal Six capabilities. The modification also provides for the installation of four retrofit A-kits and associated government-furnished B-kits on Navy P-8A aircraft. Work will be performed in Jacksonville, Florida (79.6%); St. Louis, Missouri (10.9%); and Mesa, Arizona (9.5%), and is expected to be completed in May 2030. Fiscal 2027 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $110,156,192 and Royal Australian Air Force cooperative partner funds in the amount of $9,498,042 will be obligated at the time of award. This modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Detyens Shipyards Inc.,* North Charleston, South Carolina, is awarded a $11,412,701 firm-fixed-price contract (N3220527C1259) for a 42-calendar days shipyard availability for the Midterm Availability of Military Sealift Command’s fleet replenishment oiler USNS Robert f. Kennedy (T-AO 208). This contract includes a base work package and two unexercised options for additional work and time, which if exercised, would increase the cumulative value of this contract to $11,762,866. Work will be performed in North Charleston, South Carolina, beginning Jan. 11, 2027, and is expected to be completed by Feb. 21, 2027. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $11,412,701 are obligated and will expire at the end of the fiscal year. This contract was a small business set-aside solicited via the Government wide Point of Entry website and three offers were received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Avum, Agoura Hills, California was awarded a $61,053,453 firm-fixed-price contract for software sustainment, capability delivery, technical refactoring of the Virtual Contracting Enterprise business intelligence suite into a modern microservices architecture, and the deployment of a secure contracting capability. Bids were solicited via the internet with six received. Work will be performed in Agoura Hills, California, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 3, 2031. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance, Army funds in the amount of $2,818,452 were obligated at the time of the award. Army Contracting Command, Rock Island Arsenal, Illinois, is the contracting activity (W519TC-27-C-A019).

announcements.text: Computer World Services Corp.,* Falls Church, Virginia, has been awarded a $33,842,284 ceiling firm-fixed-price contract for operation support services. This contract provides for technical, subject matter expert, and software support for Department of the Air Force telecommunications, the Defense Information Systems Network, Telecommunications Certification Office Support System and Telecommunications Circuit Allocation and Tracking System sustainment, the configuration management office, Department of Defense Mobile Satellite Services programming, and Long Haul Communications mission tasks for the Headquarters Cyberspace Capabilities Center. Work will be performed at Scott Air Force Base, Illinois, and is expected to be completed by June 30, 2034. This contract was a competitive acquisition, and three offers were received. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $341,453 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Combat Command, Acquisition Management and Integration Center, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, is the contracting activity (FA8773-27-D-0001).

announcements.text: Georgia Tech Applied Research Corp., Atlanta, Georgia, has been awarded a $9,896,783 cost plus fixed fee task order for Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) C-130J AN/ALQ-251 radio frequency countermeasures laboratory support. This contract provides for engineering services to include the development, documentation, delivery, and initial maintenance of the electronic warfare ALQ-251 Mission Data Test Station. Work will be performed in Atlanta, Georgia; and Robins Air Force Base, Georgia, and is expected to be completed by Nov. 4, 2028. This contract involves Foreign Military Sales (FMS) to Australia in support of the RAAF. This contract was a sole-source acquisition. FMS funds in the amount of $9,896,783 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Robins AFB, Georgia, is the contracting activity (FA8523-27-F-B003).
